title: MiniMax Music 3
description: Text to music: a full song or an instrumental, up to 5 minutes. Describe the music; add lyrics for a song.

controls.label: Describe the music: genre, tempo, key, instruments, mood, and the vocals.
Lyrics (with [Intro] [Verse] [Chorus] [Bridge] [Outro] tags; leave empty for no words)

hints: Write the description in three parts: the overall style (genre, tempo in BPM, key, mood), the vocals, then the arrangement (instruments and how each section sounds).
The more specific the description, the closer the result.
In the lyrics, only the tags in square brackets set the structure: [Intro], [Verse], [Chorus], [Bridge], [Outro]. The words themselves set the mood.
Longer songs take more time and more GPU memory.
The seed is random by default, so the same description gives a different take each time.
